summary: An Intelligence half-caster who works magic through tools, conjures handy gear, and builds a rotating set of temporary magic items from learned plans.

Spellcasting.summary: Half-caster using INT, with Artificer spells cast through Thieves', Tinker's or proficient Artisan's Tools as the focus (so every spell has an M component). Starts with 2 cantrips and 2 prepared level 1 spells; swap one cantrip and any prepared spells after a Long Rest.

Tinker's Magic.summary: Know Mending. Magic action with Tinker's Tools: make one basic adventuring item (rope, torch, crowbar, caltrops and the like) within 5 ft; it vanishes at your next Long Rest. INT mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

Replicate Magic Item.summary: Learn 4 magic item plans, more per the Plans Known column; swap one per level. After a Long Rest with Tinker's Tools, build 1–2 items from different plans, up to the Magic Items column's cap (oldest vanishes). Items can be attuned on creation and serve as a focus if wands or weapons.

Artificer Subclass.summary: Pick your Artificer specialty; it grants features at levels 3, 5, 9 and 15.

Ability Score Improvement.summary: Gain a feat you qualify for, such as Ability Score Improvement. Again at levels 8, 12 and 16.

Magic Item Tinker.summary: Three new tricks for items you made with Replicate Magic Item: refill charges with a spell slot, break one down into a spell slot, or turn one into another plan you know.

options.name: Charge Magic Item
options.summary: Bonus Action, touch a charged item you made within 5 ft and spend a spell slot: it regains charges equal to the slot's level.

options.name: Drain Magic Item
options.summary: Bonus Action: destroy an item you made within 5 ft to gain a spell slot (level 1 for Common, level 2 for Uncommon or Rare) that is lost at your next Long Rest. Once per Long Rest.

options.name: Transmute Magic Item
options.summary: Magic action: reshape an item you made within 5 ft into a different item from a plan you know. Once per Long Rest.

Flash of Genius.summary: Reaction when you or a creature you see within 30 ft fails a check or save: add your INT mod (min +1) to the roll. INT mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

Magic Item Adept.summary: Your Attunement limit rises to four items.

Spell-Storing Item.summary: After a Long Rest, put a level 1–3 Artificer spell (1-action casting, no consumed material; needn't be prepared) into a weapon or focus. Whoever holds it can cast it as a Magic action with your INT, at most once per turn, for twice your INT mod uses (min 2).

Advanced Artifice.summary: Attune to up to five items, and each Short Rest returns one spent Flash of Genius use.

options.name: Magic Item Savant
options.summary: Attunement limit becomes five items.

options.name: Refreshed Genius
options.summary: A Short Rest gives back one expended Flash of Genius use.

Magic Item Master.summary: Your Attunement limit rises to six items.

Epic Boon.summary: Take an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for (Boon of Energy Resistance is suggested).

Soul of Artifice.summary: Your made items can save your life, and while attuned to an item, Short Rests fully restore Flash of Genius.

options.name: Cheat Death
options.summary: Dropped to 0 HP but not killed outright: destroy any number of your Uncommon or Rare replicated items and set your HP to 20 per item destroyed.

options.name: Magical Guidance
options.summary: If attuned to at least one magic item, a Short Rest restores all Flash of Genius uses.

alchemist.summary: A potion-brewer who hands out random elixirs and boosts acid, fire, poison and healing magic.

Tools of the Trade.summary: Gain Alchemist's Supplies and Herbalism Kit proficiency (another Artisan's Tool for each you already had). Brewing potions takes half the usual time.

Alchemist Spells.summary: Always prepared at levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17: Healing Word, Ray of Sickness; Flaming Sphere, Acid Arrow; Gaseous Form, Mass Healing Word; Death Ward, Vitriolic Sphere; Cloudkill, Raise Dead.

Experimental Elixir.summary: Each Long Rest with Alchemist's Supplies, brew 2 elixirs (3 at level 5, 4 at 9, 5 at 15) and roll a d6 for each one's effect; leftovers vanish at the next Long Rest. Spend a spell slot as a Magic action to brew one more and pick its effect. Drinking or feeding one within 5 ft is a Bonus Action.

options.name: Healing
options.summary: Heals 2d8 + your INT mod; 3d8 at level 9, 4d8 at 15.

options.name: Swiftness
options.summary: +10 ft Speed for 1 hour; +15 ft at level 9, +20 ft at 15.

options.name: Resilience
options.summary: +1 AC for 10 minutes; 1 hour at level 9, 8 hours at 15.

options.name: Boldness
options.summary: Add 1d4 to attack rolls and saves for 1 minute; 10 minutes at level 9, 1 hour at 15.

options.name: Flight
options.summary: Fly Speed 10 ft for 10 minutes; 20 ft at level 9, 30 ft at 15.

Alchemical Savant.summary: Casting through Alchemist's Supplies, add your INT mod (min +1) to one healing roll or one Acid, Fire or Poison damage roll of the spell.

Restorative Reagents.summary: Cast Lesser Restoration through Alchemist's Supplies with no slot and no need to prepare it, INT mod times (min 1) per Long Rest.

Chemical Mastery.summary: Acid, Fire or Poison spells can add 2d8 Force damage once a turn; Resistance to Acid and Poison and immunity to Poisoned; a free Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron through your supplies once per Long Rest.

options.name: Alchemical Eruption
options.summary: Once your Artificer spell hits a target with Acid, Fire or Poison damage, add 2d8 Force to it. Once per turn.

options.name: Chemical Resistance
options.summary: Resistance to Acid and Poison damage; can't be Poisoned.

options.name: Conjured Cauldron
options.summary: Once per Long Rest, cast Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron through Alchemist's Supplies with no slot, preparation or materials.

armorer.summary: A tinkerer who rebuilds their own armor into a weaponized second skin with a swappable model.

Tools of the Trade.summary: Heavy armor training and Smith's Tools proficiency (or another Artisan's Tool if you had them). Crafting armor takes half the time.

Armorer Spells.summary: Always prepared at levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17: Magic Missile, Thunderwave; Mirror Image, Shatter; Hypnotic Pattern, Lightning Bolt; Fire Shield, Greater Invisibility; Passwall, Wall of Force.

Arcane Armor.summary: Magic action with Smith's Tools: the armor you wear becomes Arcane Armor until you swap suits or die. It ignores Strength requirements, dons or doffs as a Utilize action, can't be pulled off you, and works as your spellcasting focus.

Armor Model.summary: Choose a model for your Arcane Armor, changeable on a Short or Long Rest with Smith's Tools. Each has a built-in weapon that uses INT for attack and damage.

options.name: Dreadnaught
options.summary: A heavy-hitting juggernaut: a reach hammer that shoves or drags, and the power to grow to Large.

options.name: Force Demolisher
options.summary: Simple melee weapon with Reach, 1d10 Force. On a hit against a smaller creature, push it away or pull it in up to 10 ft.

options.name: Giant Stature
options.summary: Bonus Action: for 1 minute gain +5 ft reach and grow to Large if smaller and there's room. INT mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

options.name: Guardian
options.summary: A front-liner: blows that make foes focus on you, and temp HP when Bloodied.

options.name: Thunder Pulse
options.summary: Simple melee weapon, 1d8 Thunder. A creature it hits has Disadvantage attacking anyone but you until your next turn starts.

options.name: Defensive Field
options.summary: Bonus Action while Bloodied: gain temp HP equal to your Artificer level; they go away if you take the armor off.

options.name: Infiltrator
options.summary: A stealth suit: a long-range lightning shooter, +5 ft Speed, and Advantage on Stealth checks.

options.name: Lightning Launcher
options.summary: Simple ranged weapon, range 90/300, 1d6 Lightning; once on each of your turns a hit can add another 1d6 Lightning.

options.name: Powered Steps
options.summary: Your Speed goes up by 5 ft.

options.name: Dampening Field
options.summary: Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks, offsetting any Disadvantage the armor imposes.

Extra Attack.summary: Taking the Attack action on your turn gives you two attacks.

Improved Armorer.summary: Learn one extra plan that must be Armor (replace it only with Armor) and make one extra Armor item with Replicate Magic Item. Your model's special weapon gains +1 to attack and damage.

Perfected Armor.summary: Each model gets stronger: bigger weapon dice plus a new trick (a larger Dreadnaught, a Guardian that yanks foes in, an Infiltrator that marks targets and briefly flies).

options.name: Dreadnaught
options.summary: Force Demolisher deals 2d6. Giant Stature grants +10 ft reach, lets you become Large or Huge, and gives Advantage on Strength checks and saves.

options.name: Guardian
options.summary: Thunder Pulse deals 1d10. Reaction when a Huge or smaller creature you see ends its turn within 30 ft: it makes a STR save or is pulled up to 25 ft toward you, and if it lands adjacent you may make a melee weapon attack on it. INT mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

options.name: Infiltrator
options.summary: Lightning Launcher deals 2d6; creatures it shocks glow (dim light, 5 ft) and have Disadvantage attacking you until your next turn. Bonus Action: Fly Speed of twice your Speed this turn, INT mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

artillerist.summary: A ranged specialist who deploys a magical cannon and channels extra damage through a carved arcane firearm.

Tools of the Trade.summary: Proficiency with Martial Ranged weapons and Woodcarver's Tools (or another Artisan's Tool if you had them). Crafting a magic Wand takes half the time.

Artillerist Spells.summary: Always prepared at levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17: Shield, Thunderwave; Scorching Ray, Shatter; Fireball, Wind Wall; Ice Storm, Wall of Fire; Cone of Cold, Wall of Force.

Eldritch Cannon.summary: Magic action with Smith's or Woodcarver's Tools: build a Small or Tiny cannon within 5 ft (AC 18, HP 5 × Artificer level, immune to Poison and Psychic) lasting 1 hour; once per Long Rest or by spending a spell slot, one at a time. Bonus Action within 60 ft: it moves up to 15 ft and fires one mode.

options.name: Flamethrower
options.summary: 15-ft Cone: DEX save, 2d8 Fire on a fail, half on a success; sets loose flammable objects alight.

options.name: Force Ballista
options.summary: Ranged spell attack from the cannon at a target within 120 ft: 2d8 Force and a creature is shoved 5 ft away.

options.name: Protector
options.summary: The cannon and any creatures you pick within 10 ft of it gain 1d8 + INT mod (min 1) temp HP.

Arcane Firearm.summary: After a Long Rest, carve sigils into a Wand, Rod, Staff or Martial Ranged weapon to make your firearm; it is a focus, and Artificer spells cast through it add 1d8 to one damage roll.

Explosive Cannon.summary: Your cannons hit harder (+1d8 to damage and Protector's temp HP) and can be blown up on purpose.

options.name: Detonate
options.summary: Reaction when your cannon takes damage and you're within 60 ft: it explodes, and creatures within 20 ft make a DEX save, taking 3d10 Force on a fail or half on a success.

options.name: Firepower
options.summary: Add 1d8 to the cannon's damage rolls and to Protector's temp HP.

Fortified Position.summary: Run two cannons at once and shield allies around them.

options.name: Double Firepower
options.summary: Keep two cannons, create both with one Magic action (a second slot if the first cost one), and fire both with one Bonus Action in any modes. Never three.

options.name: Shimmering Field Projection
options.summary: You and allies within 10 ft of your cannon have Half Cover.

battle-smith.summary: A fighting medic and guardian who wields magic weapons with INT and fights beside a built Steel Defender.

Tools of the Trade.summary: Smith's Tools proficiency (or another Artisan's Tool if you had it). Crafting weapons takes half the time.

Battle Smith spells.summary: Always prepared at levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17: Heroism, Shield; Shining Smite, Warding Bond; Aura of Vitality, Conjure Barrage; Aura of Purity, Fire Shield; Banishing Smite, Mass Cure Wounds.

Battle Ready.summary: Martial weapon proficiency; any proficient weapon can be your focus; attacks with magic weapons may use INT for attack and damage.

Steel Defender.summary: A loyal Medium construct (AC 12 + INT, HP 5 + 5 × Artificer level, Speed 40) acts on your turn and only Dodges unless you spend a Bonus Action to command it. Revive it within an hour with a Magic action and a spell slot; rebuild it after a Long Rest with Smith's Tools.

options.name: Force-Empowered Rend
options.summary: Melee attack using your spell attack bonus, reach 5 ft: 1d8 + 2 + INT mod Force.

options.name: Repair
options.summary: The defender, or a Construct or object within 5 ft, heals 2d8 + INT mod. 3 per day.

options.name: Deflect Attack
options.summary: Reaction when a creature within 5 ft attacks someone else: that roll has Disadvantage.

options.name: Steel Bond
options.summary: The defender adds your Proficiency Bonus to its checks and saves.

Extra Attack.summary: Attack twice with the Attack action on your turn; you can trade one of those attacks for the Steel Defender's Rend.

Arcane Jolt.summary: When your magic weapon or your defender hits, channel a burst: extra Force damage to the target or healing to someone within 30 ft. Once per turn, INT mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

options.name: Destructive Energy
options.summary: The target takes +2d6 Force.

options.name: Restorative Energy
options.summary: A creature or object you see within 30 ft of the target regains 2d6 HP.

Improved Defender.summary: Arcane Jolt grows to 4d6, and Deflect Attack hurts the attacker.

options.name: Improved Jolt
options.summary: Arcane Jolt's damage and healing become 4d6.

options.name: Improved Deflection
options.summary: Each Deflect Attack deals 1d4 + INT mod Force to the attacker.

cartographer.summary: A navigator and scout who links allies with magic maps, marks foes with light, and steps through short portals.

Tools of the Trade.summary: Proficiency with Calligrapher's Supplies and Cartographer's Tools (another Artisan's Tool for each you already had). Scribing Spell Scrolls takes half the time.

Cartographer Spells.summary: Always prepared at levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17: Faerie Fire, Guiding Bolt, Healing Word; Locate Object, Mind Spike; Call Lightning, Clairvoyance; Banishment, Locate Creature; Scrying, Teleportation Circle.

Adventurer's Atlas.summary: After a Long Rest with Cartographer's Tools, hand magic maps to 2 to 1 + INT mod creatures (yourself allowed). They last until you die or remake them; holders roll +1d4 Initiative and always know where the other holders are.

options.name: Awareness
options.summary: Map holders add 1d4 to Initiative.

options.name: Positioning
options.summary: Holders sense each other's location on the same plane, and can target one another with sight-based effects despite no line of sight or cover, if within range.

Mapping Magic.summary: Cast Faerie Fire with no slot INT mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, and spend half your Speed to teleport short hops.

options.name: Illuminated Cartography
options.summary: Free castings of Faerie Fire, INT mod (min 1) per Long Rest.

options.name: Portal Jump
options.summary: On your turn, use half your Speed to teleport to a space you see within 10 ft, or next to a map holder within 30 ft. Not usable at Speed 0.

Guided Precision.summary: Once per turn, add your INT mod to one damage roll of a Cartographer spell or of an attack hitting a creature under your Faerie Fire. Damage never breaks your Concentration on Faerie Fire.

Ingenious Movement.summary: Using Flash of Genius also lets you or a willing creature you see within 30 ft teleport up to 30 ft to a space you can see.

Superior Atlas.summary: Maps can save a falling holder, and you get a free Find the Path once per Long Rest.

options.name: Safe Haven
options.summary: A holder dropped to 0 HP (not killed outright) can tear up its map to go to twice your Artificer level in HP instead and teleport beside you or another holder.

options.name: Unerring Path
options.summary: While you hold a map, cast Find the Path once per Long Rest with no slot, preparation or components.
